method: canonical best accessible build per case, beam search plus local swaps for secondary stat count vectors

assumptions.accessRules: age 4-5: normal pet/spell Epic and mount Common, +/-1 rarity; age 6-7: normal pet/spell Legendary and mount Rare, +/-1 rarity; age 8-9: normal pet/spell Ultimate and mount Legendary, +/-1 rarity
assumptions.buildCarrierSelection: highest selected equipment age/rarity only; one canonical item per non-weapon slot, best melee/hybrid/ranged weapon variants, pet trio, mount and spell trio
assumptions.secondaryPlacement: beam search width 64, then one-line local swaps; counts are capped by carrier count
